chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ṣafwān, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about the time of ghusl al-janabah: how much water suffices for it? He said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to perform ghusl with five mudd shared between him and his wife, and the two of them would perform ghusl together from one vessel.

key_terms.إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ: a single vessel used by both
key_terms.خَمْسَةِ أَمْدَادٍ: five mudd, a measured quantity of water
key_terms.صَاحِبَتِهِ: his wife or female companion in the context of shared bathing
key_terms.غُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ: ritual bath required after major ritual impurity
key_terms.يُجْزِي: is sufficient and valid for fulfilling the requirement

ai.seo_question: How much water is sufficient for ghusl al-janabah according to the hadith of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the amount of water sufficient for ghusl al-janabah, citing the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. It indicates moderation in water usage and establishes the permissibility of spouses performing ghusl together from a single vessel.
